title: Nebius Plans $40B AI Infrastructure Expansion
excerpt: Nebius aims to finance a $40 billion expansion using customer prepayments and loans amid questions surrounding its financing model.
body_html:
Nebius is moving forward with plans for a $40 billion expansion of its artificial intelligence infrastructure. The company intends to fund this large-scale initiative using a combination of customer prepayments and loans.

However, the ambitious financing strategy faces scrutiny. Recent delays involving a Microsoft data center have raised questions regarding the viability and stability of this specific neocloud financing model.
